steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each nonconformance needs a containment time, a quantity that matches the lot list, and a line on the list.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Quantity does not match the lot list
findings.fix: Reconcile the quantity to the lot

findings.title: Location not on the line list
findings.fix: Use a location from the list

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] nc-line-b.md:12  Nonconformance with no containment time.
       Fix: Record when containment started.
[medium] nc-lot-19.md:19  Quantity does not match the lot list.
       Fix: Reconcile the quantity to the lot.
[low] nc-lot-17.md:26  Location not on the line list.
       Fix: Use a location from the list.
Not checked: The cause.
pros: Checks a nonconformance with no containment time, a quantity that does not match the lot list, and a location not on the line list.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-nonconformance-report skill on the records for this review.
